subscriptions_reconcile_due_index.name: subscriptions_reconcile_due_index
subscriptions_reconcile_due_index.where:
"app"."subscriptions"."provider" = 'apple'
          and "app"."subscriptions"."user_id" is not null
          and "app"."subscriptions"."environment" in ('production', 'sandbox')

dictionary_translations_ready_output.name: dictionary_translations_ready_output
dictionary_translations_ready_output.value:
(
        "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."status" = 'ready'
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."sentence_zh_hans" is not null
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."contextual_meaning_zh_hans" is not null
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."completed_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."status" <> 'ready'
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."sentence_zh_hans" is null
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."contextual_meaning_zh_hans" is null
        and "app"."dictionary_example_translations"."selected_meaning_index" is null
      )

inventory_country_ticket_country_require.name: inventory_country_ticket_country_required
inventory_country_ticket_country_require.value:
("app"."inventory_items"."type" = 'country' and "app"."inventory_items"."country_code" is not null)
          or ("app"."inventory_items"."type" = 'universal' and "app"."inventory_items"."country_code" is null)
